page.layout: One printed page: digitiser's cover sheet. Logo at top right, title block centred, a rule, a block of licence text in two paragraphs groups, a rule, further licence text, and a logo at bottom right.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet of e-rara.ch (Universitätsbibliothek Basel), not part of the printed book: banner, logos, persistent link and licence notices left out. Printed title on the sheet: "Theses theologicae, de incarnatione filii Dei", Buxtorf, Johann, Basileae, [1643].
